news.title: Vasai-Virar ex-town planning official denied bail in ED money laundering case
news.para: A special court denied bail to Y Shiva Reddy, a former town planning official, deeming that evidence suggests he was in possession of significant illegal assets. In a related case, builder Arun Gupta's bail request was also turned down. The Enforcement Directorate linked these proceedings to allegations of land grabbing and illegal permissions, resulting in the demolition of 41 structures and displacing numerous families.

news.title: Visakhapatnam: Velampeta families agree to shift temporarily for new housing complex
news.para: Residents will temporarily relocate to rented homes for a new housing complex.  The Greater Visakhapatnam Municipal Corporation will build apartment blocks at the existing settlement.  Each family will receive a free 410 sq ft flat with basic facilities.  Rental assistance of Rs 3,000 per month will be provided until construction concludes.  This project offers a permanent solution to housing issues for 177 families.

news.title: Ahmedabad civic body implements smart queue system for property bill name transfers
news.para: Ahmedabad Municipal Corporation has launched the LogBook360 Smart Queue Management System across its seven zonal offices. This innovative digital tool simplifies the process of managing queues for services like property tax name transfers. Citizens can now effortlessly secure instant tokens from self-service kiosks, benefitting from QR code check-ins and live updates on their queue status, leading to enhanced transparency and more efficient service delivery.

news.title: ASK Property Fund invests ₹300 crore in residential projects in Ghaziabad
news.para: ASK Property Fund has allocated ₹300 crore towards two residential projects in Ghaziabad, showcasing its commitment to urban development. In a strategic move, the fund has exited a Chennai project, securing a profit of ₹340 crore. Additionally, a ₹500 crore platform partnership with Bhumika Group has been established, focusing investments in real estate across the National Capital Region, with ₹125 crore designated for a plotted development in Faridabad.

news.title: Mahindra Lifespaces to sell stakes in four associate companies for up to ₹80 crore
news.para: Mahindra Lifespace Developers has approved the sale of its entire stake in four associate companies to Omega Warehouse Holdings 2. Upon completion of the transaction, Ample Parks and Logistics, Ample Parks Project 1, Ample Parks Project 2 and Ample Parks MMR will cease to be associates of the company.

news.title: Bengaluru: Construction of illegal, high-density PG building in Whitefield halted
news.para: Residents demand accountability for unauthorized layout approvals straining civic infrastructure.  The Karnataka High Court has ordered a stay on further construction at an allegedly unauthorized development.  Many buildings have reportedly come up along a narrow access road, raising infrastructure concerns.  The court directed the Greater Bengaluru Authority Commissioner to report on actions taken.  This intervention allows an examination of the entire chain of approvals and enforcement failures.

news.title: Nagaland app for job services of construction workers launched
news.para: Nagaland has introduced the innovative LabourChowk mobile application to enhance employment services, revolutionizing how construction workers find jobs. This application allows workers to effortlessly register, explore job opportunities, and utilize welfare schemes at their fingertips. Employers can likewise engage with registered workers, promoting a streamlined connection aimed at expanding access to vital employment opportunities and support services.

news.title: West Bengal completes survey of 54.6 lakh households for PMAY
news.para: The P&RD department of West Bengal has successfully conducted a comprehensive survey of over 54.6 lakh households under the Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana. The innovative smartphone self-survey initiative has garnered nearly seven lakh applications, illustrating its popularity. Notably, South 24 Parganas district emerged as the leader in identifying over 4.8 lakh households, surpassing the projected survey completion by 123 percent.

news.title: Karnataka plans $400 billion Bengaluru region economy by 2037
news.para: Karnataka plans to expand Bengaluru's economy to $400 billion by 2037. The master plan aims to create millions of new jobs and boost key sectors. It seeks to drive private investment and finance urban transformation through land value capture. The region will be developed as a global hub for technology and advanced manufacturing. Public transport expansion and water security are also key components of this ambitious plan.

news.title: Illegal floors, land use in Madhya Pradesh to now draw GIS glare
news.para: Madhya Pradesh has unveiled GARUD, a pioneering GIS-enabled online platform designed for citizens to report building plan violations and unauthorized constructions discreetly. By consolidating municipal and utility data, the system enhances urban management. Additionally, GARUD facilitates compliance checks for aviation and heritage zones concerning new constructions. Its innovative design has earned it an Achievement in GIS Award, recognizing its significant contribution to urban planning.

news.title: Tamil Nadu launches major digitisation of historic property records
news.para: Tamil Nadu is embarking on an ambitious project to digitize millions of historical property documents and registers, ensuring valuable records dating back to 1865 are preserved and made accessible. In addition, birth and death records up to 2018 will be transformed into a user-friendly, searchable format. This initiative, designed to enhance public access to crucial historical data, is set to be completed within 14 months.

news.title: Punjab to digitise property records in urban villages through drone surveys, GIS mapping
news.para: Punjab is embarking on an innovative project to revolutionize urban village property records through the use of advanced technology. By utilizing high-resolution drone surveys and GIS tools, the initiative aims to generate precise, geo-referenced property information. This effort focuses on regularizing informal ownership while providing residents with verified property cards, thereby enhancing transparency, streamlining services, and establishing a solid geospatial foundation for future urban development.

news.title: Karnataka: KERC proposes mandatory EV charging stations in large buildings
news.para: The Karnataka Electricity Regulatory Commission has put forth new proposals for large buildings, requiring the installation of mandatory EV charging stations. Additionally, underground power cables will now be mandated in future residential developments. These initiatives are designed to enhance the reliability of power services, ensuring quicker connections for consumers and providing compensation for any service delays.

news.title: DTCP to take over OSB The Venetian land in Gurugram after project licence cancellation
news.para: Gurgaon authorities are officially seizing control of land due to the cancellation of a housing project licence. To prevent any unauthorized sale or leasing arrangements pertaining to the halted project, the department will issue public notices informing potential buyers of the current status. Updated revenue records will confirm the licence cancellation and subsequent land ownership. Allottees are strongly cautioned against making any further payments to the coloniser.

news.title: Amid court case, DTCP orders fresh inspection of Raheja Akshara in Sohna
news.para: On September 7, the DTCP is set to carry out a new inspection of the Raheja Akshara project, this decision comes after an earlier visit was delayed because a required representative was unavailable. The aim of the inspection is to evaluate the current development status of this plotted housing project, a necessary step under a High Court directive.

news.title: Pranav Constructions' ₹351-crore IPO to open on September 7 at price band of ₹118-124 per share
news.para: Pranav Constructions is gearing up for its initial public offering, set to launch on September 7, with a price band ranging from Rs 118 to Rs 124 per share. This initiative aims to secure over Rs 351 crore to boost approvals, purchase Floor Space Index (FSI), and compensate for redevelopment endeavors. The company is known for its focus on redevelopment projects in Mumbai's vibrant Western suburbs.

news.title: Supreme court agrees to hear plea against Acqua Eden on Goa hills
news.para: The Supreme Court will hear a plea from the Goa Bachao Abhiyan challenging the approvals granted for the Acqua Eden luxury residential project. The organization alleges that there was manipulation of technical information concerning the slope of the site to facilitate development and points out the absence of necessary environmental clearance. Consequently, notices have been dispatched to both the Goa government and the developer involved.

news.title: Civil aviation ministry looks at simplifying approvals for buildings near airports
news.para: The Civil Aviation Ministry is actively seeking to streamline building approval processes in proximity to airports. Urban local authorities might soon begin issuing no-objection certificates for construction ventures. To support effective planning, clear guidelines on permissible building heights will be made available promptly. This initiative aims to create a seamless, automated, and efficient NOC system, benefiting both the general public and the construction sector while prioritizing aviation safety.

news.title: Over 800 families get permanent titles after 120-year land dispute in Guntur district
news.para: In a significant development, a century-old land dispute in Guntur district has been settled. The state government has granted permanent land titles to 812 families from three villages, clarifying ownership over 41.46 acres of previously contested land. To enhance land records, authorities will introduce QR-coded passbooks following a thorough re-survey and digitisation process, aiming to address further land record challenges.

news.title: UrbanVault adds one lakh sq ft workspace in Chennai
news.para: UrbanVault has entered the Chennai market with workspace across three properties in Guindy and Velachery Main Road. The expansion comes as India’s flexible workspace operators recorded 26-44% year-on-year revenue growth in Q1 FY27, according to myHQ.
